reserves.name: USDC deposited into Gauntlet-curated Morpho lending markets

reserveReview.rationale: Morpho and Gauntlet identify USDC as the sole supply asset for the Gauntlet USDC Prime V2 vault family across its reviewed deployments. The reserve envelope is therefore one 100% USDC dependency; market allocation and available liquidity remain dynamic.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Morpho and Gauntlet USDC Prime V2 vault disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The sole tracked dependency is identified, but current deployment-level market allocations and available liquidity are dynamic.

providers.name: Gauntlet USDC Prime V2 MetaMorpho vaults on Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The vaults and Morpho markets are on-chain, but the reviewed materials do not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation treatment for deposited USDC.
